phase_policies.applies_when: At the start of the game, both sides have limited information. The opponent's posture is unknown, and your own economy and production are still developing.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when more information becomes available, such as scouting units or opponent expansion.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and expand with safety checks, keeping options open.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with safety checks. Focus on economy and expansion while keeping options open.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to army production before your economy is stable.

phase_policies.applies_when: As the game progresses into the early-midgame, the opponent's posture remains unknown, but your own economy and production are still light or uncertain. If the opponent reveals a ground posture with heavy production and economy, consider strengthening your ground army.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or expansion.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain economy and expansion, with a branch to strengthen ground army if opponent shows heavy ground.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with safety checks. Continue focusing on economy and expansion. If the opponent reveals a ground posture, consider strengthening your ground army.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army production while teching or over-expand if an attack is imminent.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the midgame, the opponent's posture is still unknown, and your own economy and production remain light or uncertain. If the opponent reveals a ground posture with heavy production and economy, consider strengthening your ground army.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or expansion.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain economy and expansion, with a branch to strengthen ground army if opponent shows heavy ground.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with safety checks. Continue focusing on economy and expansion. If the opponent reveals a ground posture, consider strengthening your ground army.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-expand without sufficient army to defend, especially if the opponent shows heavy ground production.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the late-midgame, the opponent's posture is still unknown, and your own economy and production remain light or uncertain.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or expansion.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain economy and expansion with safety checks.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with safety checks. Continue focusing on economy and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army production while teching or over-expand if an attack is imminent.
